decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - Notwithstanding the details submitted for the construction of the link road, plan 101/PLC/6/SK/A Rev. A, the link road shall be constructed of 'Grasscrete'.  The excavation depth shall not exceed the minimum necessary for such construction.

Condition : 3 - A replacement tree of same or similar species shall be planted in the position shown on the plan hereby approved during the next planting season following the construction of the access road.

Condition : 4 - A steel barrier fence shall be placed around the existing oak tree to the east of the proposed access road at a distance of no less than eight (8) metres from the outside of the trunk during the construction of the access road.
Condition : 5 - The construction of the access road shall be flush where it connects to the existing footpath.
Condition : 6 - Any damage to the existing footpath during the construction of the access road shall be repaired.
Condition : 7 - Any area where the grass has been damaged or removed during the construction of the access road shall be made good and re-turfed within one month of the completion of the access road.
description: Following approval for erection of two storey Hindu Centre, incorporating Hindu temple and two storey annexe building, linked by two storey covered walkway, with ancillary car parking details submitted pursuant to Condition 16 (access road) of planning permission reference 01501/A/P2 approved 16/12/1999.
